sources.title: Nebius press release, October 1, 2026 (Exhibit 99.1): acquisition of Inferize

event.title: Nebius acquires Inferize
event.summary: Nebius acquired inference-optimization company Inferize and moved its technology and team into Nebius Token Factory. The transaction terms were not disclosed.

facts.label: Acquisition
facts.text: Nebius acquired Inferize and integrated its technology and team into Nebius Token Factory.
facts.quote: Amsterdam, October 1, 2026—Nebius (Nasdaq: NBIS), the AI cloud company, today announced it has acquired Inferize, an inference optimization company whose technology shortens the time needed to launch and scale large AI models, making inference workloads elastic.

facts.label: Terms
facts.text: The transaction terms were not disclosed.
facts.quote: The terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
